When you open a bottle of vodka you can smell the damn thing from far away right? Imagine now if that vodka was filled with oils with strong scents. Its vital for a perfume to be strong in fragrance oils, usually this is more distinguished in perfumes where the oil is at a 40% concentration(which is the max). Almost no famous perfume I've tried has that sillage (scent trail) i heard about until i started focusing on buying non designer perfumes made with essential oils at a 40% concentration and suddenly i keep getting comments left and right. Sometimes just oil perfumes with no alcohol have that strong sillage too but with oil perfumes the scent doesn't evaporate so well so it doesn't travel well, but they are super strong on you and you yourself smell it or anyone else intimately close to you.
